Hello,

In this first beta build you will find two new modules. You may have seen them in the screenshots I posted in the sidebar of /v/ave.

Inject custom style

This one took me some time to get right. I hope you like it. I think it could become very useful.

There are two ways you can use it:

  • You can choose a custom style in the list I provided.
  • You can add the URL of a CSS file. This file needs to be sent with the MIME type "text/css" for your browser to accept it, I added a "check" button to test this.

You can also choose to show this custom style everywhere on Voat and not just pages with content (submissions and comments). Custom styles aren't made for those pages so you will notice some (a lot of) bugs.

This module works best if you check "Disable custom subverse styles" in your preferences.

FYI: chrome (and Opera) doesn't accept some CSS files, although there are served as text/css. I don't know why yet. But I hope to find out soon.

In case you installed a custom style so buggy that you can't even access AVE's preference manager to disable it, I added a panic mode. Press Ctrl+Shift+Insert to disable Inject custom style and reload the page.

Hide username

This module will replace all references to your username it can find with the name of your choice. Everywhere, but in comments though.

It also proposes an option to simply remove your username from the user block at the top right of the screen.

Misc.

  • The FixExpandImage solution to expand over the sidebar is a CSS fix that didn't work so well everywhere. Some of you (whom I thank for telling me about it) noticed it in a several places. I am trying a variant of this fix, I hope it will be less intrusive.
  • The preference manager's saving function has been simplified. It will, now, only save the modules you have modified and will show the saving process.
  • Some minor fixes have been added too. There is not much more in the changelog.

Thanks a lot to everyone who decided to try AVEβ, you are great!
